display.purpose: Hero sections and major surface titles.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for main calls to action like 'Submit Gem' or 'Search'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(28 100% 50%); color: hsl(0 0% 100%); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s, background 0.2s; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid hsl(28 100% 50% / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions that shouldn't compete with the primary flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: hsl(0 0% 9%); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid hsl(60 5% 88%); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(60 5% 92%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid hsl(28 100% 50% / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Standard text input field for searching and filtering.
components.css: .ds-input { background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(0 0% 9%); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid hsl(60 5% 88%); width: 100%; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: hsl(28 100% 50%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(28 100% 50% / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: Earthy, tactile, and restrained. It should feel like a well-crafted field journal that lets the photography and user tips shine. The design prioritizes the content over flashy UI, creating a warm, inviting, and trustworthy environment for real discovery.
keyCharacteristics: Warm & Earthy: Colors evoke the natural landscapes of Nepal.
Restrained: The UI steps back so user-submitted photography can take the spotlight.
Physical & Clear: Interactions feel tangible and intentional, suitable for on-the-go travelers.

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: The Sunset Orange and Glacial Cyan are used sparingly. If a screen feels overwhelmingly colorful, tone it down. Color exists to guide, not distract.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest on the canvas. Shadows are reserved strictly for temporary overlays or sticky interactive elements that must float above content.

dos: Do use the Cream Background instead of pure white for the main app canvas.
Do rely on the 12px (0.75rem) border radius for all main interactive elements and cards.
Do keep the interface flat and rely on borders for component definition.
donts: Don't use decorative shadows on static cards or images.
Don't overuse Sunset Orange. It should remain a clear indicator of action or primary focus.
Don't use highly stylized display fonts; the typography must remain highly legible for travelers reading on small screens outdoors.
